Mrs. Lynde possesses a sonsy, kindly, and matronly appearance.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## Personality

A capable and farseeing woman, Rachel Lynde is known as a pretty good judge of human nature who keeps a sharp eye on everything that passes. Known for being kindly and generous, she is also a bossy busybody who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. She takes an active interest in church affairs and is a passionate, red-hot politician. Despite her critical and officious tendencies, she remains a genuinely good person who never shirks her share of work. Beyond her opinionated nature and love of giving advice, she possesses notable sewing and dressmaking skills.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde, who was married at age eighteen, raised ten children and buried two while living as a long-time housekeeper in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). When [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) set out to adopt a child, Rachel visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to warn [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the dangers of bringing in an unknown orphan. Upon meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Rachel offended the young girl by criticizing her looks and red hair, provoking a fierce outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before receiving a dramatic apology and forgiving her. Rachel went on to offer advice on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), including sewing her a stylish dress with puffed sleeves for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), and she frequently kept [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informed about community developments and village gossip. Following the death of her husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Rachel moved in with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a step that enabled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to step down from teaching in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and pursue her education at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Rachel helped oversee young [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, frequently attempting to guide Davy's behavior and religious upbringing. Over the following years, she kept track of town updates, supported [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through various milestone life events, and eventually informed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's sudden, critical illness.

## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde initially got off to a rocky start with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after offending her with blunt remarks about her appearance, provoking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a passionate rage. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologized, Rachel freely forgave her, eventually growing to act as an affectionate neighbor who consults on her upbringing, listens to her remorseful confessions, and warmly cautions her to care for her health.
